name: Turn meeting notes into who does what by when
audience: Anyone who runs meetings and loses the follow-ups
summary: Read a transcript or a page of notes and pull out every commitment somebody made: what, who, and by when. Things nobody owned are listed separately rather than assigned to whoever spoke last.
needs: The notes as an attachment on the run, or in a granted folder

steps.instruction: Read the notes and pull out every action somebody committed to. One record per action: what was agreed, who owns it, the deadline, and the sentence it came from. Copy the owner's name exactly as written. If nobody was named, the owner is null — do not assign it to whoever was speaking. If no date was given, the deadline is null.

Write the follow-up. A short list of what was decided, then the actions grouped by owner with deadlines. Put actions with no owner under a heading saying they need one, and actions with no deadline under a heading saying they need a date. Quote the source sentence beside each action.
